mapper.sql: select trace_id, clue_id, action, action_desc, before_status, after_status, operator_id, operator_name, operate_time, remark from jc_clue_trace
mapper.select: where clue_id = #{clueId} and del_flag = '0' order by operate_time asc, trace_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into jc_clue_trace (clue_id, action, action_desc, before_status, after_status, operator_id, operator_name, operate_time, remark) values (#{clueId}, #{action}, #{actionDesc}, #{beforeStatus}, #{afterStatus}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update jc_clue_trace set del_flag = '2' where clue_id = #{clueId}
